player_prompt.intro:
Kei te takaro koe i 2048 ki runga i te papa {board_size}x{board_size}. Ko tau whāinga ko te tae atu ki te wahanga {target_tile} ma te kōtuitui i ngā tau ruarua i runga i te kotahi!
Neke tūturu: [Up], [Down], [Left], [Right]. Ka hono ngā wahanga ina whakawhiti, ka ruarua te uara.

invalid_move.no_change: Kāore te poari i huri - ka whiriwhiri he aronga rerekē.

outcome.lose: Kore rawa he nekeneke. Wahanga nui {max_tile} - tohu whakamutunga {score}.
